expectations.text: Explains you are entitled to see your credit bureau file, with the fee waived if denied credit recently (within 30 days per the book)
expectations.evidence: free report after denial (30 days mentioned)

expectations.text: Advises reviewing the report and disputing errors
Mentions the Equal Credit Opportunity Act 'user' designation so a married person gets credit for accounts in the spouse's name
expectations.evidence: ECOA, joint accounts reported in both names

expectations.text: Notes many routine payments (rent, utilities, phone, medical) are not reported to credit bureaus
expectations.evidence: does not mention routine payments going unreported

expectations.text: Mentions current free access via annualcreditreport.com and/or FCRA dispute rights as an update to the 1989 book
Mentions skepticism toward paid credit-repair or credit-credential services
